d:
A collaborative superhero (mostly) kemoshota hentai doujinshi, originally released as a physical book at Kemoket 16 on September 21, 2025, it received a PDF download version for purchase briefly after, on September 24, 2025. The digital purchase has two versions, the normal full resolution PDF, and a "lite" version that is smaller in file size (the original pdf is over 500 megabytes). This gallery was made by converting the individual pdf pages into pngs, so there may be some loss in quality.

Pardon if my info is wrong, but the circle is called "ねこかぶり" (Nekokaburi, or nekobr, as the URL for the Booth store calls the circle), which is hosted/led by Tooboe.

The links provided are for Tooboe primarily, as I'm uncertain I can identify all the artists included in the book, so tagging those who apply would be greatly apreciated.

Host artist's links:
https://nekokbr.booth.pm/ (where you can buy this circle works, including this very book)
